source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Change all/random setting to non-default in this BIOS function.
3. Save and reboot.
4. Boot in to BIOS and  check your setting still exist.
5. Press load default,save and reboot.
6. Boot in to BIOS,setting in this function should match the SPEC.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. No error log happen.
2. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
3. Check your setting still exist.
4. The default setting should matches SPEC."

original_test_intent: Verify that approved PCI Subsystem Settings persist across save/reboot and return to SPEC defaults after Load Default without unexpected PCIe link, resource, device-enumeration, boot or OS regressions.
original_method: Change PCI Subsystem fields in BIOS, save/reboot and verify persistence; then Load Default, save/reboot and compare with SPEC while checking logs, reboot and device/management health.
manual_activity: A human must navigate PCI Subsystem Settings, perform the approved field changes and both save/reboot/default phases, and inspect firmware values. Automated PCI inventory cannot exercise the firmware controls.
required_inputs: Named PCI fields with baseline, safe non-default and SPEC-default values
Physical slot-to-BDF/device map and boot-critical devices
Expected link/resource/virtualization/hot-plug effects for selected fields
Console/operator, stable power and OOB recovery
Final PCI configuration and workload disposition
safety_requirements: Never operationalize all/random; approve each PCI field/value and affected device.
Protect the boot device, mounted/in-use storage, management NICs and active GPUs from unapproved disappearance or reconfiguration.
Do not write to devices or filesystems as an implicit enumeration check.
Stop on missing device, link degradation, resource failure, IOMMU error, hang, crash, boot or management loss.
Restore the approved final PCI configuration.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only PCI topology/link/resource, GPU/storage/network, OS kernel and BMC health evidence.
Compare firmware captures and before/after device identity against the approved matrix.
Do not drive BIOS, perform unapproved device resets/writes, infer slot mapping or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Define/approve the PCI field/default/effect matrix, critical devices and recovery.
Evaluate firmware and device/link/resource evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects the pre-OS UI as agent-runnable. No source command exists; OS PCI tools are read-only supporting checks and must preserve exact device identity and platform applicability.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain manual BIOS changes and add platform-approved read-only PCI topology/link/resource and driver/log snapshots; do not substitute OS rescan, reset, bind/unbind or configuration-space writes.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source two-phase sequence, no-script state and 5/20-minute fields are preserved; all/random remains source text but is not safe execution scope.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map each approved BIOS field to affected slot/BDF/device, expected link/resource/virtualization behavior and abort condition; capture firmware values and read-only topology at baseline, non-default persistence, default restoration and final state.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact board/chipset/BIOS and installed PCIe topology.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC, OS/kernel and PCI inventory-tool versions plus device firmware identifiers where relevant.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform PCI Subsystem specification, slot map and project topology.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact device causality and non-destructive evidence while preserving both firmware transitions.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction for selected fields; no claim of hot-plug, SR-IOV or performance coverage unless those behaviors are explicitly included.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Field/default/effect matrix, slot/BDF map and critical-device recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: BDFs may change after resource policy changes; physical identity/serial/slot correlation must be preserved.

project_override_considerations: The project may select a safe PCI field subset and relevant device classes. Completion applies to that matrix and cannot be reported as all slots/features or destructive I/O validation.
expected_evidence: Platform identity, approval, topology/critical-device baseline and recovery readiness
PCI field/non-default/default/effect matrix and slot/BDF map
First save/reboot persistence plus link/resource/device inventory
Load Default, second save/reboot, SPEC comparison and normal-boot evidence
Final storage/network/GPU/management health, logs and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently require persistence and SPEC-default restoration. Missing field and topology definitions are execution-readiness gaps, not contradictions.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The PCI-settings intent is clear. Project topology, values and recovery are mandatory for safe execution but do not make the library case permanently BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees with manual classification and adds PCI resource/topology safety and evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains critical-device, link/resource and recovery controls while applying V3.1 readiness semantics.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates read-only enumeration support, project feature scope and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents random PCI firmware changes from hiding boot or data-path devices and establishes a non-destructive, identity-preserving topology comparison.
independent_technical_reasoning: The core firmware controls and value observations require human BIOS interaction, so MANUAL ONLY applies. Automated topology evidence can reveal effects but cannot validate the UI behavior alone.
no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat a PCI setting change, reboot or default load after any enumeration/link/resource/boot anomaly; preserve first-failure topology and obtain engineer disposition.
